items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-27
items.q: I'd try to see how fast I could get off of that. And we'd sit down and talk with Buddy. And I'd ask him questions about his horn.

ctx.x: Well, what was it like on the other side? Beautiful.

I can remember the trees and the green shrubbery. A few homes. Beautiful homes sitting in these, under these great big trees. Of course, you had the slum area over there. Well, now I wouldn't say slum. I hate to use it. Yeah. But, for instance, Buddy B.T. lived in the great trumpet players about 25, 30 years ahead of time. He lived in the little one room shack and he took a vacuum to me. And every time I would go to the dock, I'd try to see how fast I could get off of that. And we'd sit down and talk with Buddy.…
One of the things I was trying to get in there from a slant and vicular way as a country.
